findings.claim: FY2025 關稅對成本與營收的影響：客戶回收關稅使銷售增加約 $80M；關稅費用使銷貨成本年增約 $108M。
findings.excerpt:
Customer recoveries relating to tariffs increased sales by approximately $80 million.

•Tariff expense resulted in a year-over-year increase in cost of sales of approximately $108 million.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：2025 年美國對歐盟、加拿大、墨西哥、中國等課徵關稅，已推高原料與零件成本，並引發中國等報復性關稅；USMCA 2026 年待更新，中國供應鏈整合帶來特有風險。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement ("USMCA") is subject to renewal in 2026. There can be no assurance that the USMCA will be renewed or, if renewed, any newly negotiated terms in the USMCA will not adversely affect our business.

findings.claim: 公司以採購區域調整、長約、成本分攤、設計變更、雙源、客戶 buy program 等手段緩解關稅與出口禁令影響，2026 年起沿用。
findings.excerpt: The Company uses long-term contracts, cost sharing arrangements, design changes, dual sourcing, customer buy programs and limited financial instruments to help control costs. The Company intends to use similar measures in 2026 and beyond.
